summary.text: Tief Gibbs is the Republican candidate for California State Senate District 2, an open seat with no incumbent, in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Damon Connolly.
A Novato small business owner, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she wants to restore the economy, public safety and housing.

paragraphs.text: Tief Gibbs was born in Palo Alto, California, and earned a bachelor's degree from San Diego State University in 1995, according to Ballotpedia, which lists her as Tief Gibbs Jensen.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she is a California native who lives in Novato and that she and her husband, Walter, own and operate Vintage Vehicles in downtown Novato.
She said she serves on the board of the Novato Downtown Business Association, is president of the Novato Republican Women Federated and is a California Republican Party delegate.
Gibbs advanced from the June 2, 2026 primary to the general election against Connolly.
In the survey she said she wants to reduce spending, lower taxes, restore public safety and address housing.
